command.name: security key-manager keystore show
command.description: This command displays all keystore configurations.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore configurations with the given Vserver.

parameter.name: keystore-type
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore configurations with the given keystore type.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore configurations with the given configuration name.

parameter.name: enabled
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore configurations with the given enabled value.

parameter.name: uuid
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystore configuration with the given universal unique identifier (UUID) value.

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the keystores with the given state.

example.p: The following example lists all keystore configurations.
example.screen:
Cluster-1::*> security key-manager keystore show
Vserver Keystore Type Config Name Enabled ---------------------- -------------- ------------------ ------- Cluster-1 OKM default true vs0 AKV default true vs0 AKV AKV-Config-1 false vs1 AKV AWS-Config-1 true 4 entries were displayed.
example.p: The following example lists only the keystore configurations that are enabled.
example.screen:
Cluster-1::*> security key-manager keystore show -enabled true
Vserver Keystore Type Config Name Enabled ---------------------- -------------- ------------------ ------- Cluster-1 OKM default true vs0 AKV default true vs1 AKV AWS-Config-1 true 3 entries were displayed.
